source: DataForSEO (Google Trends Explore, DataForSEO Trends subregion interests, Google Ads search volume, YouTube organic SERP), pulled 2026-11-20

method.trends: Google Trends web, United States, weekly 2024-10-27 to 2026-11-14 (107 complete weeks; partial week of 2026-11-15 dropped). Three calls, each including 'botox': [botox, lip filler, morpheus8, semaglutide, laser hair removal], [botox, hydrafacial, microneedling, coolsculpting, sculptra], [botox, daxxify]. The botox series was identical in the first two calls (peak 100 = week of 2026-03-01), so those 9 terms share one scale.
method.avg_interest_12m: Mean of the last 52 weeks (2025-11-16 to 2026-11-14) divided by botox's mean over the same weeks x 100 (botox = 100). avg_interest_12m_raw is the raw Google Trends value (botox peak week = 100).
method.change_pct: Mean of last 13 weeks (2026-08-16 to 2026-11-14) vs the same 13 weeks one year earlier (2025-08-17 to 2025-11-15).
method.peak_month: Calendar month (by week start) with the highest mean weekly value within the last 52 weeks.
method.volume: Google Ads search_volume (12-month average) and monthly_searches 2025-11..2026-10, United States, English. volume_trend_direction compares mean of last 3 months (2026-08..10) vs first 3 months (2025-11..2026-01): >+10% up, <-10% down, else flat. Google Ads buckets volumes (e.g. 135k/165k/201k), so month-to-month moves are coarse.
method.by_state: DataForSEO Trends subregion_interests, web, past 12 months, one call with the 4 terms. 'interest' = per-term 0-100 index across states (100 = that term's top state nationally). 'interest_shared_scale' = absolute_items, one shared 0-100 scale across all 4 terms and all states, so it compares terms within a state.
method.youtube: serp_youtube_organic_live_advanced, United States, English, desktop, block_depth 20. videos_about_brand_top20 counts video results within the first 20 result blocks that are clearly about this brand (channel cards and playlists not counted; same-name businesses excluded). newest_video_age is YouTube's relative publication_date of the newest qualifying video.

treatments.note: Separate 2-term call with botox anchor (its botox series re-normalized slightly differently: botox avg 76 vs 77). Values are 1-2 on the 0-100 scale, so change_pct is low-resolution.

notes: Botox is the anchor (avg_interest_12m=100). On the shared scale, semaglutide (60.7), microneedling (40.3) and laser hair removal (38.9) are the next-largest; lip filler 21.7; sculptra 9.0; hydrafacial 7.0; coolsculpting 4.7; morpheus8 3.1; daxxify 2.4.

Fastest-rising (last 13 weeks vs same weeks a year ago): laser hair removal +14.2%, microneedling +14.0%, sculptra +9.7%, lip filler +7.2%. Falling: coolsculpting -17.8%, semaglutide -15.9%, hydrafacial -12.1%, morpheus8 -11.1%, botox -3.5%. Daxxify shows +62.5% but its weekly values are only 1-2, so treat as low-resolution.

Semaglutide Google Trends interest collapsed in autumn 2026: weekly values 53-70 in Feb-Jun 2026, then 20-25 from late Sep to mid-Nov 2026. Google Ads monthly volume still shows 368,000 for 2026-10 (buckets lag/are coarse), so the two sources disagree on the latest month.

Botox: Google Ads monthly volume spiked to 368,000 in 2026-09 and 201,000 in 2026-10 vs a 135k-165k baseline; this drives its 'up' volume direction (+48.3%), while Trends shows -3.5% for the last 13 weeks. The spike is a single-month Ads reading.

Microneedling had the strongest spring surge in Trends (from ~19-21 in spring 2025 to 40-52 in Mar-May 2026) and remains above prior-year levels; laser hair removal peaked Jun 2026 (45-49) and is now back near 19-21 but still above the prior year.

Google Trends relative interest and Google Ads absolute volume do not line up one-to-one (e.g. semaglutide is ~61% of botox in Trends but 2.2x botox in Ads volume; sculptra Ads volume 110,000 vs Trends 9% of botox). Use Ads volume for sizing and Trends for direction/seasonality.

Seasonality: most aesthetic terms peak March-April (botox, morpheus8, semaglutide, coolsculpting in 2026-03; lip filler, microneedling, sculptra in 2026-04); laser hair removal peaks June; hydrafacial May.

By state (per-term index): botox highest in DC 83, MO 76, CT 72, NY 72; lip filler highest in CT 100, DC 93, OR 67, FL 64; semaglutide highest in DC 100, UT 89, OR 80, OK 76, SC 72; morpheus8 highest in CT 56, FL 28, NC 26 among requested states (Minnesota is the national 100, not in the list). Morpheus8 index is 0 in DC and very low (1-11) in most other requested states.

YouTube: only 3 of 24 brands have a qualifying video newer than 3 months (Blush Med Spa 3 weeks via local TV, Avelure 2 months via sponsored TV, Cúrate 2 months via WKRN). 4 brands have zero brand videos in the top 20 (22, Back to 30, Ever/Body, SkynBar) and Nouveau Day Spa had none clearly attributable. Several owned libraries are large but dormant 4+ years (EsthetixMD, Pūr Skin Clinic, BeautyFix, H-MD, Living Young, New Radiance).
Brand-name ambiguity on YouTube (Glo Med Spa, Illumé, Nouveau, The AgeLess Center, 22, Reflections Medical) means counts for those should be confirmed against each location's city before publishing.
No volumes or interest values were estimated; every number is from a DataForSEO tool result on 2026-11-20.
